result.topic_en: Draft opening of a letter dated Leipzig, 24 September 1858, thanking the addressee for a letter received in Hamburg, with a small sketch of a broken-line graph, a derivative-like formula and a short list of words.
result.transcription:
Leipzig[?] den 24 September 1858

Mein liebe Ida[?]!

[-...-]

[-Ueber-] Deinen lieben Brief, den ich in Hamburg erhielt, habe ich mich sehr gefreut

[sketch: horizontal segment, vertical line, descending stepped/oblique segment to a horizontal axis]

$\frac{dx}{dq} = x$ .

Einzahl[?]. Zahlwort[?]. Weber[?]. Auditorium.

methods.what: Differential relation (derivative of x with respect to q equals x)
